NERVES. [36] [Chel.]
Restlessness. θ Erysipelas. θ Influenza.
Sudden restlessness of limbs, must move ; feet move involuntarily. θ Pneumonia.
Trembling of whole body, with faintness, nausea and anxiety.
Trembling and twitching of limbs.
Pricking as with needles, in different places.
Twitching in muscles on awaking.
Subsultus tendinum, with slight delirium. θ Hepatic symptoms.
Tonic spasms in flexors of fingers and toes.
General numbness with somnolence.
Lethargy. θ Valvular disease.
Prostration. θ Chorea.
Great debility and lassitude.
Great languor and faintness. θ Influenza.
Cannot raise himself in bed without assistance.
Great weariness and anorexia. θ Pneumonia. θ Liver complaint.
Weariness, indolence, indisposed to work.
Fainting, with cold extremities.
Aversion to motion ; tired from least exertion.
Great discomfort.
Paralytic drawing and lameness in single parts.
Neuralgia, particularly right supraorbital.
Neuralgia connected with injuries. θ Chorea.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Chel.]
Frequent yawning.
Sleepy, lethargic in daytime. θ Jaundice.
Constant sopor, with a sunken face. θ Pneumonia.
Sleepiness, desire to lie, without being able to sleep.
At 2 P. M. drowsiness so marked even in open air that she was near falling asleep while walking.
Falls asleep, while speaking, for several minutes at a time. θ Laryngitis.
Unusual wakefulness towards 4 A. M. from various complaints.
Cannot go to sleep because of a cutting pain in calves and upper arms, alternating with headache.
Cannot sleep because of numbness and coldness of extremities.
Sleepless, with headache.
Wakes up repeatedly, feeling wretchedly.
Unrefreshing sleep from vivid dreams about business matters. θ Dyspepsia.
Restless sleep : full of dreams ; before midnight.
Awakes terrified, by the usual sufferings.
Sweat during sleep, after midnight and towards morning, passing off soon after awaking.
Awakes in morning perspiring, after many unremembered dreams. θ Liver complaint.
Dreams : of corpses and funerals ; frequent and vivid ; confused.
On awaking he cannot remember what he dreamt about.
   

TIME. [38] [Chel.]
At night : excitement, confusion of intellect ; quiet delirium ; occiput feels heavy ; in bed, supraorbital neuralgia < ; on waking, pressure in right maxilla ; in bed, toothache < ; profuse perspiration ; attacks of asthma ; pain behind sternum.
After midnight : sweat during sleep.
Towards 4 A. M. : wakefulness.
At 4 A. M. : many symptoms <.
Towards morning : profuse general perspiration.
Morning : giddiness ; headache ; thick blood in nasal mucus ; attacks of supraorbital neuralgia ; agglutination of lids ; dimness of eyes ; cough, with expectoration ; straining cough, with expectoration ; on awaking, chilliness and cold feet ; occasional perspiration ; on awaking, spots on face.
Through day : lethargy.
Afternoon : tearing from right ear into teeth ; intermittent fever ; dry heat.
At 2 P. M. : stitches and soreness in lungs ; drowsiness.
At 2 or 3 P. M. : headache begins.
At 3 P. M. : complete intermission of pain in eye ; attack of neuralgia in left eyebrow and temple ; shivering.
From 4 to 9 P. M. : pain in right kidney and liver.
At 5 P. M. : hoarseness.
At 8 or 9 P. M. : headache at its height.
Towards evening : repeated chill, dry heat ; cheeks red, head and left eye very hot.
Evening : in bed, tearing in left eye ; hot spell ; in bed, chill ; rigor ; after lying down, internal heat without thirst ; copious sweat.
During day : frequent erections.
All day : strangury.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Chel.]
Renewal of ailments on change of weather.
Warmth : < supraorbital neuralgia ; < toothache and facial neuralgia.
Cold water : > supraorbital neuralgia and toothache.
In room : chill passes off.
In open air : headache < ; oppression of breathing > ; drowsiness ; chill, while walking.
Air : < pain in right eye ; airing room caused a chill, pneumonia.
From getting feet wet : ophthalmia.
   

FEVER. [40] [Chel.]
Internal chill : with severe shaking, evening in bed ; when walking in open air, passes off in room.
Chill and coldness of whole body ; < on hands and feet, with distension of veins.
Towards evening repeated chill.
Chilliness, with cold feet, in morning on waking.
Shivering from time to time. θ Inflammation of eyes.
Shivering : without external coldness ; running down back.
Shivering, with chattering of teeth.
Yawning and shivering before attack. θ Neuralgia.
Skin cool and rough. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Icy coldness of right foot. θ Pneumonia.
Violent fit of shivering daily, 3 P. M., for a whole hour, with pains in head as from a band tightly bound around forehead and temples. θ Acute rheumatism.
Attacks of rigor in evening. θ Liver complaint.
Intermittent fever, paroxysm coming every afternoon ; hot stage < than cold ; bright yellow stool.
After a severe rigor vertigo and vomiting. θ Pneumonia.
Rigor, followed by heat and sorrowful, anxious mood. θ Valvular disease.
Great and dry heat, especially in face ; in afternoon, particularly towards evening ; rigors ; moderate thirst. θ Influenza.
Constant chilliness, except towards evening, when cheeks become red and head and left eye feel very hot ; towards morning, profuse general perspiration, so that bed is wet through. θ Prosopalgia.
Violent fever. θ Pneumonia.
Heat : of head and face ; on scapulæ ; in hip joints.
Heat of head, dark red cheeks, pulsation in arteries ; full pulse ; faintness ; difficulty of speech ; nausea ; short breath ; cold feet.
High fever ; pulse 110 ; skin burning hot and perspiring ; great heat and confusion of head ; great thirst ; sunken countenance. θ Laryngitis.
Internal heat without thirst, evening after lying down.
Internal and external heat, warm perspiration of face, neck and chest, with vertigo and nausea.
Burning heat of hands, spreading from thence over body.
Moist burning skin.
Skin hot, with watery, sour-smelling sweat. θ Acute rheumatism.
Perspires from slightest exertion. θ Hepatic calculus.
Copious evening sweat.
Perspiration occasionally in morning. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Sweat during sleep, after midnight and towards morning ; > after awaking.
Typhous complication in epidemic bronchitis.
